profile_text.body:
DeepAI, incorporated as Deep AI, Inc. and founded in 2017, describes itself as an all-in-one creative AI platform built for general audiences. The company traces its origins to late 2016, when it launched what it claims was the first browser-based text-to-image generator. Its current platform allows users to generate images, edit photos, create short videos, compose music, and chat with an AI voice assistant or an internet-browsing text assistant, all accessible through a web browser or via APIs.

The company's tracked product is its image generation tool available at deepai.org, categorized under image and graphic design. Beyond consumer features, DeepAI states it also undertakes custom technical work for governments, nonprofits, and research organizations, including computer vision systems and perception and mapping pipelines across sensor networks. It additionally describes an "AI for Good" initiative focused on conservation and social impact, noting that in 2025 it became the major sponsor of Tuvalu's national futsal team.

No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company. DEEPAI and the Dolphin Design are registered trademarks of Deep AI, Inc. in the United States and other territories, with the Dolphin Design copyright dated 2023.
